Assistant Manager - Business Consulting Risk - National - CBS - FIN - FP&A Account Support - Pune Requisition Id: 1759707 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self. The opportunity : Assistant Manager-National-Business Consulting Risk-CBS - FIN - FP&A Account Support - Pune National : National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience. CBS - FIN - FP&A Account Support : EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are : Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses. Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management. Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence Demonstrated expertise in financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling. Proficient in variance analysis to identify drivers behind actual-versus-plan performance and recommend corrective actions. Skilled in preparing accurate, timely management reports that translate complex financial data into clear insights. Strong command of advanced Excel for data consolidation, reconciliation, and building dynamic financial models. Experience creating interactive dashboards and visualizations in Power BI to support performance tracking and decision-making. Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification Chartered accountant Experience Financial Analysis (3+ years) What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach. What we offer Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities. EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing. If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now
• It is a Full Time Accountant job for candidates with 3 - 6+ years Experience.

We value autonomy, self-reliance, fast movers, a passion for robust and ability to maintained quality of financial reporting.

• Managing the monthly reporting process, ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information to internal and external stakeholders.

• Preparing the Daily/ monthly flash for Orders and Sales at SYSS/ Site level
• Determining Correct revenue recognition method for Projects
• Revenue & COS Recognition in Oracle system for Projects

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /in
About Industrial Markets

The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.

At SKF, we provide industry-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day-to-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.
SKF Purpose Statement

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
JOB DESCRIPTION

Reports To: India Industrial Controller

Role Type: Team Management

Location: Pune
Key Responsibilities
• Business planning, budgeting and forecasting: Prepare the annual business plan and monthly, quarterly, and rolling forecasts. Coordinate the planning and monthly outlook processes for the Industrial Business. Consolidate, review, and analyse forecasts in Anaplan or other approved reporting tools. Provide clear actual-versus-forecast analysis by month and quarter.
• Mid- and long-range planning: Develop the mid- and long-range financial plan. Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate strategic options through scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis.
• Financial performance analysis : Conduct detailed contribution-margin, gross-margin, and PLP analysis. Assess price, mix, and volume movements by segment, SKU, and customer against the prior year, including PS and LPC impacts.
• Customer and order-book analysis: Identify high-, low-, and negative-margin customers and explain the key drivers of performance. Analyse the order book and operating margin by segment.
• Pricing governance: Support the business with pricing and margin analysis and simulations. Track OEM price increases by segment. Maintain a central repository of customer ARCs and monitor price-escalation clauses and related commercial exposure.
• Restatement: Complete the annual restatement process in accordance with SKF requirements and the agreed timetable.
• Inventory management: Monitor OEM inventory and work with KAMs to deliver reduction plans. Review dead and slow-moving stock, assess the adequacy of obsolescence provisions, and coordinate liquidation actions with KAMs and segment heads. Develop and monitor targeted inventory-reduction initiatives.
• Business performance support: Provide structured communications, timelines, and guidance to segment heads. Deliver profitability analysis by segment, product, and customer. Investigate errors affecting India results and coordinate corrective action with the relevant stakeholders. Review revenue, operating margin, and net working capital performance with segment heads, highlighting successes, risks, and required actions.
• Decision support: Perform ad hoc analysis, simulations, and financial modelling to support business decisions.
Key Performance Indicators
• Annual business plan: Submit the complete business plan by the agreed deadline, with all key assumptions, risks, and supporting schedules documented and approved. Prepare the presentation deck in accordance with management guidelines.
• Forecast accuracy: Submit the monthly forecast by WD5. Maintain revenue and operating-profit forecast variance within ±5% of actual results. Document the causes of material deviations and agree corrective actions with segment heads. Prepare the annual forecast template and circulate it monthly for segment inputs.
• Long-range planning: Complete the mid- and long-range plan according to the annual timetable, including base, upside, and downside scenarios with quantified financial impacts.
• Scenario analysis: Deliver standard what-if analyses within three working days and complex analyses by the agreed deadline. Clearly document assumptions, sensitivities, and financial implications.
• Segment analysis: Complete monthly contribution-margin and PLP analysis for all segments by WD8. Explain at least 90% of material variances against the Business Plan and prior year.
• Margin improvement: Review all negative-margin customers monthly. Assign an owner and due date to every material case, track actions to closure, and quantify the expected margin benefit.
• Business support: Deliver at least 90% of agreed pricing, margin, and ad hoc analyses by the committed deadline, with no material data or calculation errors.
• Pricing governance: Track all approved OEM price increases by segment. Escalate overdue or unimplemented actions within five working days and report realised versus planned impact monthly.
• Contract and restatement controls: Maintain a complete repository of active OEM ARCs and other pricing agreements. Flag relevant clauses before their due dates and complete each restatement review according to the agreed closing timetable.
• Inventory and obsolescence: Coordinate bi-weekly inventory reviews with Logistics, covering month-on-month movements and the drivers of changes in DCD, SRO, and SRO GIT. Issue a bi-weekly status report to segment heads and the Customer Service team. Assess all identified dead- and slow-moving inventory and complete at least 90% of agreed reduction or liquidation actions by the due date.
Education & Experience
• Chartered Accountant or Cost and Management Accountant with 12–14 years of relevant experience.
• Strong experience in business controlling, FP&A, and commercial finance.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI, SAP/ERP.
• Strong communication, stakeholder-management, networking, and influencing skills.
• Demonstrates integrity and the courage to challenge constructively.
• Business planning, budgeting and forecasting
• Mid- and long-range planning
• Business performance support
• Inventory management
